title: Officiality Loses Sincerity
body:
We are trying to be simple and not official. I want to be able to speak freely and not for it to be like a courtspeech. It should be free and simple so that sincerity can go through our hearts. When something is official it
loses sincerity. So forgive me for my simplicity. It is better to be simple and easy. Officiality makes our life
less valuable. Official people live shorter than unofficial. That is why I do not like to be an official person and
I have never been one. People at the top always have too many problems.
LONDON - 07.03.1993
